levels.surface: الحسن بن محمد بن عبد الله بن عيسى

notes: «أبي» is the compiler's father, named only by relation, so a relation link
the saying is Mansur's first-person account of his encounter with the Imam; whether the Imam is a link or the encounter is only in the scene is not settled by the rules (rule 11)
the Imam is not written as a link; the chain stops at منصور, the one Uthman quotes
«- بُزُرْج -» is an editor's gloss and is left out
